description: The steps to track affiliate sales on one payment platform, filled in with this account's own tracking script and webhook address: the same text the Integrations page gives to AI assistants. Use it to help add the tracking script to the site and pass the referral to checkout, then check_tracking to confirm it works. Connecting the platform itself happens in the browser (connectLinks: Stripe in one click, the others on the Integrations page), and for Stripe, Paddle, Polar and Creem connecting there sets up the webhook, so a manual webhook step is only needed without that connection. Requires Pro plan or higher, or a new account that has not picked a plan yet.

platform.description: Where the business takes payment. payment-links covers Stripe Payment Links, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy.
